FairPlayInfo.banner: ⚖️ Fair Play is on for this session
FairPlayInfo.enforced: Players who've played more than {{limit}} games are temporarily blocked from going on court or queuing, so those who've played less go first; they're restored automatically once caught up.
FairPlayInfo.notEnforced: There aren't many players here yet, so anyone can play freely for now (yielding kicks in once it gets busier).
FairPlayInfo.rule1: • The system takes the average game count of the "most-played" group; anyone above (that average + the host's setting) yields for a while.
FairPlayInfo.rule2: • Players who haven't used up their grace games aren't limited; blocked players are restored automatically once everyone catches up.
FairPlayInfo.rule3: • If you want to play but you're blocked, wait for others to play a few games and raise the average — then you can queue again.
